Inverse-error weighting gives proportionally more influence to consistently better models while still including all 19 for robustness across correlation groups.

DBA iteratively optimizes weights to minimize loss, testing whether data-driven optimization beats fixed robust averaging (median/trimmed_mean) under unstable ranking (tau=-0.185) and high error correlation (0.903).
Diverse pool: one per correlation group + seasonal anchor, testing whether small diverse pool beats full pool under unstable ranking

Per-horizon top-3 SMAPE weighting on 7-model pool; motivated by unstable cross-window ranking (tau=-0.185) and different best models per window, which a static combination cannot adapt to along the 13-step horizon.

Test if error-proportional weighting within the 4-model diverse pool outperforms equal-weight median, leveraging the seasonal_strength=0.984 and unstable ranking (tau=-0.185) by letting stronger models lead while keeping diversity
Test whether more concentrated softmax weighting helps or hurts under unstable ranking (tau=-0.185); inverse_error already tested at 1.0149

Test arithmetic mean on the 4-cluster-diverse pool4: if models are all in similar error range and from different correlation groups, mean may use all information better than median, which effectively averages only the 2 middle values of 4.

Robust aggregation on diverse 4-cluster pool; tests if trimmed mean outperforms pure median by using more than 2 of 4 values while still trimming extremes. Motivated by strong seasonality (0.9834) causing horizon-specific model errors and unstable ranking (tau=-0.185).

DBA on the 4-model diverse pool: tests if optimal linear combination of models from 4 independent correlation groups beats the robust median leader, exploiting complementarity at different horizons within the 13-step seasonal window.

Median over pool5 (ETS, THETA, DWT_rf, FT_rf, DWT_catboost, ONLY_CWT_catboost) to test whether including explicit seasonal models alongside wavelet models in a robust median improves over pool4, leveraging the 0.9834 seasonal strength and unstable ranking

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.99. Series context: trend strength 0.7865 and seasonal strength 0.9834; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.185); 1 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.305.
